fixture_guard: Reject if a fixture median is more than3 percent slower and a strict majority (minimum2) of paired repetitions are more than3 percent slower.
exactness: All complete non-timing result and configuration fields, full fingerprints, stopping iterations and exploitability bits match. Every raw run remains preserved.

Then unchanged prospective wide-turn holdout versus E020 and fresh-original3 alternating cumulative pairs under the original aggregate/fixture/exactness gates. Freeze any conditional harness and all needed builds separately before execution; no adoption from primary alone.
measurement_boundaries: Frozen compressed3-fixture native complete cycles include construction/allocation, GPU initialization including runtime NVRTC/JIT, fixed-quality solving/checks and full readback. Cargo, final fingerprinting/destruction, browser/API latency and disk saving excluded. Warm driver cache disclosed.

conditional_reach_qualification_if_pass.status: Required prospective policy only; do not implement or run a conditional harness until fixed primary qualifies.
conditional_reach_qualification_if_pass.oracle: Separate immutable E020 and candidate E027 builds on identical registered inputs; compare both players logical reach words by node/row/hand, excluding only declared physical padding. Same-layout candidate-to-candidate equality is insufficient.

Preserve exact old/new words and failures; no approximate or compressed-only oracle.
conditional_reach_qualification_if_pass.padding: Exercise nonmultiple-of-eight hand counts and already-aligned counts; verify valid logical words and untouched padding/outer guards. Empty/zero work retains guards as appropriate. Preserve true hand bounds and E015 paired-reach reuse behavior.
conditional_reach_qualification_if_pass.workspace_capacity: Check actual full and compact reach slice lengths against plan reach_pitch/reach_elements and the padded public estimate/admission; exact/tight budget behavior, both players, and required continuation paging/stored board/workspace swaps. A same-layout numerical comparison alone does not satisfy this accounting/lifecycle gate.
conditional_reach_qualification_if_pass.scope_limits: Existing full-state/F32/lock/resume/continuation controls remain mandatory; a small raw-row check does not replace them. No new timing metric, additional primary samples, exclusions or rescue are authorized.
conditional_reach_qualification_if_pass.on_failure: Reject qualification and retain all evidence; no silent fallback, budget relaxation, fixture substitution or outcome-triggered extension.
